t_advice_summary_textbox.text: tall hats often have good returns, try out different colours to see which are more likely to give higher mushroom payouts. don't forget to press the space key to collect

vb_textbox.text: tall hats generally give the best returns except for the red and brown pair. Sometimes points are very low and it might be good to swap your choice for a few rounds. Its easy to miss pressing the space bat so concentrate on not missing it
